comment: apply.c use_pole() 3528: a polearm applied at a statue trap. A debug Valkyrie steps off the stairs, wishes a statue trap under herself (wizterrainwish makes the trap and its statue), walks two squares west, takes off her shield, wishes a glaive and applies it at the statue: activate_statue_trap() animates the leprechaun and use_pole() takes the empty feedback branch.
